name: replacement after troubleshooting
transcript:
[T1] Agent: neuromodulation this is sam can i get your first and last name and a phone number
[T2] Caller: it's [NAME] [PHONE]
[T3] Agent: and what is the reason for your call today
[T4] Caller: my controller says no device found when i try to charge it started two days ago
[T5] Agent: let's take out the battery pack and read me the serial number that starts with n l d
[T6] Caller: n l d one zero seven nine one seven n as in nancy
[T7] Agent: great now plug the controller into the wall do you see a green light flashing
[T8] Caller: yes it is flashing
[T9] Agent: it sounds like the recharger cord needs replacing i'll submit a replacement request and send it overnight

device_ids.name: Controller
device_ids.quote: n l d one zero seven nine one seven n as in nancy

reason.text: that the controller showed No Device Found when the patient tried to charge
reason.quote: my controller says no device found when i try to charge

onset.text: The patient said the issue started two days ago.

troubleshooting.sentence: Agent walked the patient through removing the battery pack and plugging the controller into the wall.
troubleshooting.quote: let's take out the battery pack

troubleshooting.sentence: The patient confirmed the green light on the controller was flashing.

name: transfer out before a reason
transcript:
[T1] Agent: neuromodulation this is jo can i get your first and last name and a phone number
[T2] Caller: i'm a patient with a pacemaker is this cardiac support
[T3] Agent: this is the neuromodulation line let me transfer you to cardiac support

status_evidence.quote: let me transfer you to cardiac support

record.labeller_notes: The caller reached the wrong line and was transferred before describing a device issue.
